sentences.en: People who are unconscious can't say they want to die.
sentences.zh: 失去知觉的人不能说他们想死。

sentences.en: Sometimes machines can make an unconscious person breathe for years.
sentences.zh: 有时候机器可以让一个失去知觉的人呼吸好几年。

sentences.en: She was unconscious for a whole day after the accident.
sentences.zh: 事故发生后她整整一天处于昏迷状态。

phrases.zh: 斯库拉昏迷（注：此词组可能专有名词，具体含义需根据上下文确定）

senses.zh: 失去知觉的；不知道的；未察觉的
